spec_match.rationale: Reads navigator.userActivation inside the real launchQueue.setConsumer callback of an app whose manifest declares launch_handler client_mode focus-existing — the exact surface named by the spec step and the ChromeStatus feature-detection note.

interactive.rationale: Consumer registered at load and logs every delivery with in-callback, +1 task and +6 s isActive reads; two tab-baseline buttons read the real UserActivation state with a gesture and after expiry.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Feature-index blurb matches what the page does and states the installed-app requirement.

edge_cases.rationale: Distinguishes the initial navigating launch (labelled heuristic, expected false) from live focus-existing deliveries; +6 s column shows expiry; tab baseline shows sticky hasBeenActive vs transient isActive.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite has 4 automatic surface checks (launchQueue, setConsumer, LaunchParams targetURL/files, UserActivation booleans) and 2 manual assertions for the grant and its exclusions — the behavioural contract cannot be automated from a page because it needs an installed app and OS launches.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chrome for Testing 153 headless via Playwright at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3: context panel reported launchQueue present / browser tab; load read isActive=false; click read isActive=true; 6 s later isActive=false, hasBeenActive=true. Console/network clean. The installed-app consumer path could not execute (no app install in headless).

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert on live deliveries (isActive must be true) and on the click baselines; no assert claims a pass for paths that did not run.

design_system.rationale: Design-system variables only; dark surfaces carry explicit ivory text; button overrides set both background and color.

accessibility.rationale: Native controls with labels, 44px targets, visible focus outline, role=status live readouts, captioned tables in focusable labelled scroll regions.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 or 1280x800; all controls usable on both. The launch path itself exists on desktop and Android installed apps; File Handling (launch-to-present file path) is desktop-only and documented as such.

openQuestions.title: Observe the real grant in an installed app on Chrome 160
openQuestions.detail: Install the concept, keep its window open, relaunch via an app shortcut and confirm the consumer logs isActive=true; then relaunch Chrome with --disable-features=WebAppLaunchHandlerUserActivation and confirm false. Not possible headless here (Chrome for Testing 153, no app install).

openQuestions.title: Inspect the accessibility tree with chrome-devtools-mcp
openQuestions.detail: chrome-devtools-mcp unavailable in this environment (project rule 7b); semantics verified from DOM only.

openQuestions.title: Validate the initial-vs-live delivery heuristic
openQuestions.detail: LaunchParams does not expose started_new_navigation; the page classifies the first delivery within 4 s of load as the navigating launch. Confirm on a slow-starting installed app that a quick relaunch is not misclassified.

guidanceConsulted.query: web app manifest launch_handler launchQueue focus-existing
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Give the manifest a stable explicit id and link it from the document; install through browser-controlled UI (navigator.install()/<install>) with honest result handling.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each concept links its own manifest.json with an explicit id = concept path, scope = concept folder; the install button calls navigator.install() only when present and reports the outcome in a role=status line, otherwise it is disabled with an aria-describedby explanation pointing to the browser menu.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: 44px touch targets; size the label of checkboxes/radios; let components adapt to their container.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All buttons/links-as-buttons min 44px; checkbox/radio rows are 44px-tall labels; context grid uses auto-fit minmax(min(100%,12rem),1fr); tables live in a labelled, focusable horizontal scroll region so the page itself never overflows at 360px.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-chrome-platform-showcase/654081b3-9e1a-5f02-a6f0-8cd1f1e41633/scratchpad/shots/m-matrix-b.png; scrollWidth === clientWidth at 360x740 on every concept

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region status log updates
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native controls, labels, and polite status/live regions for asynchronous state changes; tables with caption + th scope.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verdicts/readouts are role=status aria-live=polite; delivery tables have captions and scoped headers; every control is a native button/select/input with a visible label.

summary: Canonical probe built against the exact surface the ChromeStatus entry names. Tab-side baselines verified; the real focus-existing grant needs an installed app on Chrome 160 and was not observed here.
